title.zh: 获取A号码报备OSS配置信息
title.en: Obtain OSS Configuration Information for Number A Filing

descriptions.zh:
- 您在上传A号码手机号个人报备照片时，需上传正面人像（照片清晰，人脸无遮挡）照片、选择上传身份证正反面照片（非必选）。上传后有助于审核人员了解您的个人身份信息。支持png、jpg、jpeg 格式，图片大小不要超过2M。

- 您在通过API提交A号码手机号个人实名报备时，具体操作流程请参见[API提交A号码手机号个人实名信息](~~2880077~~)。
descriptions.en:
- When uploading personal filing photos for an A-number mobile phone number, you must upload a clear frontal portrait photo with the face unobscured, and optionally select to upload photos of both sides of your ID card. Uploading these photos helps reviewers understand your personal identity information. Supported formats are PNG, JPG, and JPEG. The image size must not exceed 2 MB.

- For the specific operation flow when submitting personal real-name filing for an A-number mobile phone number through the API, see [Submit Personal Real-Name Information for an A-Number Mobile Phone Number via API](~~2880077~~).
